standard_prerequisites: Groupoids, Definition groupoids-definition-principal-homogeneous-space: the notion of a G-torsor

The construction and equivalence conclusion of lemma-non-descending-property-projective: the blowup tower over an open subset of projective three-space yields a proper non-projective morphism, and on the inverse image E of C union D there is a rational equivalence L-zero plus g of L-zero equivalent to zero
Descent, Lemma descent-lemma-affine, noting that a closed immersion is an affine morphism: closed subschemes satisfy descent
More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-regular-local-UFD: a regular local ring is factorial; hence on a smooth complex threefold an effective divisor gives rise to a line bundle

Chow Homology, Lemmas chow-lemma-proper-pushforward-rational-equivalence and chow-lemma-factors: the degree of a line bundle on a proper scheme over a field is well defined on one-cycles modulo rational equivalence
core_obligations: The involution g sending coordinates x, y, z, w to y, x, w, z acts on projective three-space over the complex numbers, freely off the two disjoint lines L-one of points with x equals y and z equals w, and L-two of points with x equals minus y and z equals minus w; Y is the complement of the two lines and Y maps to its quotient S, a smooth quasi-projective scheme, as a G-torsor; explicitly S is the image of Y under the Proj map to Proj of the invariant ring, which is C of u-zero, u-one, v-zero, v-one, v-two modulo the relation v-zero times v-one equals v-two squared, with the u variables in degree one and the v variables in degree two

The conics C and D lie in the invariant open Y and are interchanged by g; the action lifts to V-Y, the blowup construction of the companion lemma performed over the open Y rather than all of projective three-space, and switches the inverse images of Y minus P and Y minus Q; this gives a descent datum on V-Y relative to the G-torsor, and V-Y over Y is proper but not projective as shown in the companion proof

X is the disjoint union of the open subsets Y minus P and Y minus Q, with surjective etale maps X to Y to S; the pullback V over X is projective over X since V-Y is a blowup over each piece, and the descent datum pulls back to a descent datum on V relative to the etale covering X to S

If this descent datum were effective in the category of schemes by some U, then U would be the quotient of V-Y by its G-action; by descent of closed subschemes there is a curve L-one inside U, isomorphic to the projective line, whose inverse image in V-Y is L-zero union g of L-zero

Choose a function f in the local ring of U at a complex point R of L-one that vanishes at R but not on all of L-one; an irreducible component of its vanishing locus of codimension one closes up to an irreducible effective divisor D-U in U containing R but not all of L-one; the inverse image D of D-U in V-Y is an effective divisor meeting L-zero union g of L-zero without containing either line

Since the complex threefold V-Y is smooth, O of D is a line bundle, using that a regular local ring is factorial; its restriction to the proper surface E has positive degree on the one-cycle L-zero plus g of L-zero, which is however rationally equivalent to zero on E by the companion proof; this contradicts well-definedness of the degree, so the descent datum is not effective and no scheme U exists
proof_roadmap: Build the free quotient S of the invariant open Y and the lifted action on the blowup tower
Pull the descent datum to the etale cover X where the pullback is projective
Descend the two exceptional lines and derive a divisor with strictly positive degree on a rationally trivial cycle
